entries.raw: 1. The semantic Hamiltonian formalism revealed quantized semantic energy levels and welldefined energy spectra, with energy gaps ∆En,n+1 (0.15-0.45 normalized units) as measurable signatures for different semantic interpretations.
entries.title: The semantic Hamiltonian formalism revealed quantized semantic energy levels and welldefined energy spectra, with energy gaps ∆En,n+1 (0.15-0.45 normalized units) as measurable signatures for different semantic interpretations

rec.title: Computer-aided Semantic Signature Identification and Document Classification via Semantic Signatures

entries.raw: 2. Time-dependent perturbation theory effectively modeled context evolution, demonstrating state fidelity exceeding 92% over typical discourse intervals, validating dynamic meaning transitions.
entries.title: Time-dependent perturbation theory effectively modeled context evolution, demonstrating state fidelity exceeding 92% over typical discourse intervals, validating dynamic meaning transitions

match.title: Time-dependent perturbation theory

entries.raw: 3. Quantum semantic field theory, using a continuous parameter space for semantic operators, successfully reproduced linguistic phenomena like semantic priming with over 89% accuracy against psycholinguistic data.
entries.title: Quantum semantic field theory, using a continuous parameter space for semantic operators, successfully reproduced linguistic phenomena like semantic priming with over 89% accuracy against psycholinguistic data

rec.title: Continuous Hopfield dynamics of semantic vector-based activation patterns predict variations of priming effects over items

entries.raw: 4. Decoherence theory, via the Lindblad master equation, accurately modeled semantic information loss with calculated decoherence timescales (τD 20-100 operational steps), aligning with empirical context stability.
entries.title: Decoherence theory, via the Lindblad master equation, accurately modeled semantic information loss with calculated decoherence timescales (τD 20-100 operational steps), aligning with empirical context stability

rec.title: Decoherence, Master Equation for Open Quantum Systems, and the Subordination Theory

entries.raw: 5. Pointer state analysis identified robust semantic interpretations with significantly longer coherence times (3-5 times longer), explaining stability in certain meanings.
entries.title: Pointer state analysis identified robust semantic interpretations with significantly longer coherence times (3-5 times longer), explaining stability in certain meanings

rec.title: Longer Hemodialysis Survival in Certain Racial Groups Linked to Nutrition and Inflammation

entries.raw: 6. The Qiskit implementation achieved high process fidelities (over 90%) for semantic evolution operators and successful density matrix reconstruction (fidelities 0.91±0.03 for 2-qubit, 0.85±0.05 for 3-qubit systems), demonstrating practical feasibility.
entries.title: The Qiskit implementation achieved high process fidelities (over 90%) for semantic evolution operators and successful density matrix reconstruction

rec.title: Rapid Surface Reconstruction of Te-Doped NiFe Layered Double Hydroxide for Robust Oxygen Evolution at High Current Density

entries.raw: 7. Advanced noise mitigation strategies improved effective fidelities by 15-25%, highlighting practicality in noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices.
entries.title: Advanced noise mitigation strategies improved effective fidelities by 15-25%, highlighting practicality in noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices

rec.title: Practical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Methodsfor Radar Micro-Doppler Classification on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) Hardware

entries.raw: 8. Custom semantic observables Osem quantified specific semantic properties, revealing measurable quantum coherence and context-dependence.
entries.title: Custom semantic observables Osem quantified specific semantic properties, revealing measurable quantum coherence and context-dependence

rec.title: Semantic Coherence-based User Profile Modeling in the Recommender Systems Context
rec.container: Proceedings of the International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Information Retrieval
